texts.facts: The Petitioner has filed this petition under Sec.166 of the M.V. Act, seeking compensation of Rs.25,00,000/- for the injuries sustained by him in a road traffic accident dated 01.04.2021. 2. The accident caused due to the rash and negligent act of the driver of the Car bearing Reg.No.KA-02-ML-4133. The jurisdictional Basavanagudi Traffic police have registered a case against the driver of the offending vehicle in Cr.No.0011/2021 p/u/Sec.279 & 337 of IPC. Therefore, the 1 st respondent being the RC Owner and the 2nd respondent being the Insurer of the said offending vehicle are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation to him. Hence, this petition. He has denied the rash and negligent driving of the driver of the Car. The driver of the car had a SCCH - 25 5 MVC No. 2152/2021 valid DL as on the date of accident. Therefore, prayed for dismissal of the petition. It has denied the petition averments except admitting the issuance of policy in favour of the 1 st respondent in respect of the Car bearing No.KA-02-ML-4133. There is non-compliance of Sec.134(c) and 158(6) of MV Act. The driver of the offending Car did not have valid DL as on the date of accident. Further denied the occurrence of the accident and involvement of the Car in the accident. The petitioner was not wearing ISI marked headguard at the time of accident. The petitioner was not holding valid DL to ride the vehicle as on the date of accident. There was a negligence on the part of the petitioner as on the date of accident. It has also denied the age, occupation and the manner of accident. It has contended that the compensation claimed by the petitioner is excessive, arbitrary and disproportionate. Therefore, prayed for dismissal of the petition against it.
